no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held, and no external consultations were obtained as there were no issues that needed input from external experts.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA213464 (LAMPIT/nifurtimox). The Multidisciplinary Review states in Section 11 that no advisory committee meeting was held and no external consultations were obtained because there were no issues requiring input from external experts. Earlier administrative correspondence noted that a decision on convening an AC would be made during NDA review; ultimately none was held, so the AdComm had no influence on the approval.
